long-covid.title: Recommendations for the primary care management of post COVID and post acute infectious syndrome: a comparative analysis of international guidelines.
long-covid.authors: Brand, Marlene, Bellmann-Strobl, Judith, Franke, Christiana, Scheibenbogen, Carmen et al.
long-covid.excerpt: The medical care of people with post COVID syndrome (PCS) and other post-acute infectious syndromes (PAIS) remains a major challenge as dedicated care structures are scarce, diagnostic evaluation is often complex, and curative therapies are largely lacking. General practitioners play an essential role in initial assessment and the coordination of care and treatment.

long-covid.title: Primary cilia orchestrate the multi-organ network in metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis.
long-covid.authors: Zhao, Yafang, Tian, Zijiao, Dou, Dou, Li, Ruoxuan et al.
long-covid.excerpt: Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH) is an increasingly prevalent cause of chronic liver disease and a major driver of cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma worldwide. Although its pathogenesis involves complex interactions among metabolic, inflammatory, and neuroendocrine processes across multiple organs, current therapeutic strategies remain largely liver-centric and fail to address this...

long-covid.title: Persistent neutrophil maturation deficits associate with cognitive impairment in individuals with post-acute sequelae of COVID-19.
long-covid.authors: Papatheodorou, Ioanna, Lázničková, Petra, Feglarová, Tereza, Blažková, Gabriela et al.
long-covid.excerpt: Post-COVID-19 condition, or post-acute sequelae of COVID-19 (PASC), is characterized by persistent cognitive impairments and immune dysregulation. While neutrophils are critical in acute COVID-19, whether their long-term functional dysregulation contributes to PASC, remains unclear.

long-covid.title: Obesity and prolonged recovery: Assessing exercise-related oxygen and cardiovascular kinetics in post-acute COVID-19, a control study in adults.
long-covid.authors: Sobral, Claudia Cristina Conde Holanda, da Luz Goulart, Cássia, Stein, Ricardo, Borges, Robson Fernando et al.
long-covid.excerpt: To evaluate the kinetics of oxyhemoglobin (oxy-[Hb/Mb]), deoxyhemoglobin (deoxy-[Hb/Mb]), heart rate (HR), and oxygen consumption (V̇O

long-covid.title: Higher incidence of paediatric autoimmune liver disease post-COVID.
long-covid.journal: Journal of pediatric gastroenterology and nutrition
long-covid.authors: Warner, Suz, Mtegha, Marumbo Paul, Kostova, Mariana, Jayaprakash, Kavitha et al.
long-covid.excerpt: A higher incidence of autoimmune conditions with greater disease severity is reported post-Coronavirus Disease (COVID). The incidence and disease severity of paediatric autoimmune liver disease (AILD) post-COVID has not been assessed.

long-covid.title: Feasibility of a community-based physical activity programme in individuals with Long Covid: insights from the Hertfordshire longitudinal observational programme.
long-covid.authors: Logue, M, Lyus, R, Edwards, B
long-covid.excerpt: This study explores the feasibility of implementing and evaluating a community-based physical activity programme for individuals with Long Covid in Hertfordshire, UK. Long Covid presents unique challenges including fluctuating symptoms, post-exertional malaise and difficulties with re-engagement following symptom flare-ups.

mcas.title: Serum Vitamin D Levels and Antihistamine Treatment Response in Chronic Spontaneous Urticaria: A Retrospective Cohort Study.
mcas.journal: International archives of allergy and immunology
mcas.authors: Okumus Guclu, Aysu, Seren, Orbay Tutku, Ozaydn Unal, Sultan, Karatas, Hakan Ömer et al.
mcas.excerpt: Chronic spontaneous urticaria (CSU) is often refractory, and some patients do not achieve control with second-generation H1-antihistamines (sgAHs). Vitamin D has immunomodulatory effects relevant to mast cell biology, but its relationship with sgAH treatment response, as distinct from disease presence or severity, is poorly characterized.

mcas.title: Basophil Activation Testing: From Diagnostic Adjunct to Precision Allergy Management.
mcas.authors: Catamerò, Francesco, Han, Jooeun, Karabacak, Deniz Eyice, Hoffmann, Hans Jürgen et al.
mcas.excerpt: Basophils are rare circulating granulocytes that trigger immediate hypersensitivity reactions through IgE-mediated degranulation and also contribute to innate immunity. The basophil activation test (BAT) is a flow cytometry-based functional assay that quantifies basophil reactivity and sensitivity following allergen stimulation, offering a safe, blood-based alternative to in vivo provocation testing.

mcas.title: Adjunctive oral butyrate supplementation in chronic spontaneous urticaria: A randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial.
mcas.journal: Asian Pacific journal of allergy and immunology
mcas.authors: Chiamruchikun, Patcharat, Mitthamsiri, Wat, Sangasapaviliya, Atik, Jaisupa, Nattapon et al.
mcas.excerpt: Chronic spontaneous urticaria (CSU) is a chronic inflammatory and mast-cell driven skin disease. Butyrate has been extensively studied for its anti-inflammatory effects and its ability to inhibit mast cell activation.

mcas.title: 4-O-(E)-Feruloyl-N-feruloyloctopamine suppresses mast cell-mediated allergic airway inflammation and pulmonary fibrosis.
mcas.authors: Kim, Yeon-Yong, Jeong, Seungwon, Jang, Hyun-Jae, Lee, Seung Woong et al.
mcas.excerpt: Previous studies demonstrated that ferulic acid exerts therapeutic effects on various inflammatory disorders, including arthritis, acute respiratory distress syndrome, and asthma. We synthesized a novel ferulic acid derivative (4-O-(E)-feruloyl-N-feruloyloctopamine, FOA), which has not been analyzed previously.

mcas.title: KQS1 peptide represses food allergic responses via Dectin-1-dependent H3K27me3 epigenetic silencing of
mcas.authors: Zeng, Haotao, Zhao, Miao, Xie, Jinbiao, Zheng, Yadong et al.
mcas.excerpt: KQS1 is a bioactive peptide derived from red bean that has shown anti-allergic activity in preclinical models; however, its effects on mast-cell responses and the epigenetic mechanisms potentially involved remain incompletely defined. To investigate whether preventive oral administration of KQS1 attenuates food-allergy-associated responses and its mechanism.

mcas.title: Recurrent mitotic error and purifying selection shape chromosomal mosaicism across human tissues.
mcas.journal: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
mcas.authors: Tang, David, Kamitaki, Nolan, Si, Yichen, Sexton, Corinne E et al.
mcas.excerpt: Mosaic chromosomal alterations (mCAs) have been extensively studied in cancer and clonal hematopoiesis but less so in healthy solid tissues. Here, we characterized mCAs in 19 tissues across 25 donors (aged 42-89+ years) by analyzing >200x whole-genome sequencing data generated by the Somatic Mosaicism across Human Tissues (SMaHT) Network.

mcas.title: ROS-Responsive Diselenide-Bridged Dendritic Mesoporous Silica Nanoparticles Enhance Licochalcone D Delivery for Atopic Dermatitis Therapy Associated with Oxidative Stress Modulation and JAK2/STAT5 Inhibition.
mcas.authors: Liu, Hua, Ma, Qingsong, Fan, Huiping, Zhang, Dong et al.
mcas.excerpt: Atopic dermatitis (AD) involves type 2 inflammation, oxidative stress, and aberrant JAK/STAT signaling. Although localized JAK modulation is attractive, delivery remains challenging.

mcas.title: Oral live and heat-killed
mcas.authors: Wang, Xinxin, Gong, Qianjin, Wu, Daoyan, Hong, Wei et al.
mcas.excerpt: Atopic dermatitis (AD) is a chronic, relapsing inflammatory skin disease that often requires long-term management. Probiotics have been investigated as adjunctive approaches for AD, but their effects are highly strain specific.

mcas.title: Laryngeal involvement in chronic spontaneous urticaria-associated angioedema: Is there a genuine risk?
mcas.authors: Valerieva, Anna, Perego, Francesca, Stancheva, Irena, Petkova, Elena et al.
mcas.excerpt: Chronic spontaneous urticaria (CSU) affects up to 1% of the population, and 40% of patients develop concomitant angioedema (CSU-AE). While clinically significant laryngeal involvement in mast cell-mediated CSU-AE is considered rare, and large cohorts report no fatal airway compromise, patients frequently present to emergency departments with symptoms perceived as potentially airway affecting.

mcas.title: Garlic-derived S-allyl-L-cysteine ameliorates colon-spleen axis pathology in acute colitis.
mcas.journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
mcas.authors: Han, Deping, Liang, Ruijuan, Zhu, Fengxia, Guan, Xuke et al.
mcas.excerpt: S-allyl-L-cysteine (SAC), a bioactive organosulfur compound derived from aged garlic, exhibits anti-inflammatory properties, yet its cellular targets and systemic mechanisms in ulcerative colitis (UC) remain undefined. This study aimed to investigate whether SAC confers protection against dextran sulfate sodium (DSS)-induced colitis and to elucidate its mechanism of action, with a particular focus on the...

mcas.title: Chemotherapy-induced mast-cell degranulation constrains tertiary lymphoid maturation in lung cancer brain metastasis.
mcas.authors: Fu, Minjie, You, Muyuan, Ao, Yongqiang, Zeng, Guichang et al.
mcas.excerpt: Tertiary lymphoid structures (TLSs) support local adaptive immunity and are associated with favorable antitumor responses across multiple cancers. However, how anticancer treatment reshapes TLS maturation, particularly in lung cancer brain metastasis (LCBM), remains poorly understood.

mcas.title: Baseline immune profiles are associated with positive outcomes in young children with a peanut allergy, enrolled in a randomised clinical trial for oral immunotherapy.
mcas.journal: Allergy, asthma, and clinical immunology : official journal of the Canadian Society of Allergy and Clinical Immunology
mcas.authors: Coenen, Isabelle, Figliomeni, Abbey, Parkin, Kimberley, de Asis, Judy et al.
mcas.excerpt: Peanut allergy affects around 3% of Australian infants, can cause life-threatening anaphylactic reactions and often persists throughout life. Oral immunotherapy (OIT) is a promising treatment to achieve desensitisation, but treatment outcomes vary.

mcas.authors: Huang, Shun, Shen, Chuqiao, Xu, Chen, Wang, Xiyang et al.
mcas.excerpt: Diarrhea-predominant irritable bowel syndrome (IBS-D) is frequently accompanied by anxiety and intestinal barrier dysfunction, yet the central mechanisms linking stress-related neural signaling to peripheral colonic injury -30y remain incompletely understood. To investigate whether paraventricular hypothalamic nucleus (PVN) CRF/CRF-R1 signaling acts upstream of colonic barrier dysfunction and whether...

mcas.title: Germination-Assisted LAB-Fermented Soy Protein Gel Matrices with Reduced Sensitizing Potential: Associations with Epitope Disruption, Epithelial Transport, and Mucosal Immune-Cell/Cytokine Shifts.
mcas.journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
mcas.authors: Wang, Yaqiong, Wang, Yi, Yao, Zhijie, Rui, Xin et al.
mcas.excerpt: Food allergenicity reflects gastrointestinal bioaccessibility, epithelial transport, and immune recognition rather than intrinsic protein properties alone. Using germination-assisted lactic acid fermentation to engineer soy protein matrices with distinct microstructures, we systematically examined allergen fate across digestion, epithelial transport, and immune responses.

mcas.title: Expression of endoglin (CD105) and its correlation with mast cells across different grades of oral epithelial dysplasia and oral squamous cell carcinoma: A retrospective comparative study.
mcas.journal: Journal of oral and maxillofacial pathology : JOMFP
mcas.authors: Sharma, Deep, Ojha, Anuradha, George, Jiji, Singh, Ankita et al.
mcas.excerpt: Oral epithelial dysplasia (OED) represents a histopathological spectrum of oral potentially malignant disorders that may progress to oral squamous cell carcinoma (OSCC). Angiogenesis plays a pivotal role in tumour initiation, progression, and metastasis.

mcas.title: Basophil FcεR1γ signaling regulates gut barrier integrity and systemic antibacterial immunity during malaria with a sex bias.
mcas.authors: Céspedes, Nora, Fellows, Abigail M, Donnelly, Erinn L, Kaylor, Hannah L et al.
mcas.excerpt: Malaria predisposes individuals to concurrent bacteremia, a complication associated with increased intestinal permeability and mast cell (MC) activation. These effects correlate with elevated type-2 cytokines, including interleukin (IL)-3, IL-4, and IL-10.

mcas.title: Allergen-IgE Affinity Regulates FcεRI Cluster Internalization and Induces Effective FcεRI Desensitization in Mast Cells.
mcas.authors: Nagata, Yuka, Kimura, Miyu, Urayama, Mutsumi, Furukawa, Atsushi et al.
mcas.excerpt: The immunoglobulin E (IgE) receptor FcεRI undergoes dynamic changes in response to allergens (i.e., Ags; antigens) and IgE properties. Mast cell (MC) responses to high-affinity (dinitrophenyl [DNP]-Fab) and low-affinity (nitrophenyl [2NP]-Fab) Ags demonstrated that affinity differences between Ag and IgE determine subsequent cellular reactions.

mcas.title: Inner-Surface Charge Mapping in Confined Systems via Electrical Double-Layer Dynamics.
mcas.authors: Gao, Jianyuan, Feng, Yiwen, Zhu, Yufeng, Ma, Hongyang et al.
mcas.excerpt: Surface charges at solid-liquid interfaces govern diverse emerging interfacial phenomena, yet their quantification in confined geometries remains challenging. Here, we report an electrical double-layer dynamics-enabled method for inner-surface charge characterization (EISC), using water as a mobile and conformal probe.

mcas.title: Immune heterogeneity and the immune-barrier-hydrops framework in Ménière's disease: current evidence, uncertainties, and testable hypotheses.
mcas.authors: Guan, Dongmei, Liu, Xinghong, Zhang, Xiaoyi, Zhang, Jingqi et al.
mcas.excerpt: Ménière's disease presents with episodic vertigo, fluctuating sensorineural hearing loss, tinnitus, and aural fullness, and commonly features endolymphatic hydrops. Yet similar hydropic phenotypes arise in patients with markedly different clinical courses, patterns of bilateral involvement, and treatment responses, suggesting that more than one upstream process may lead to hydrops.

mcas.title: Discovery of scutellarin as a MRGX2 agonist via MRGX2/CMC strategy and revelation of its pseudo-allergic mechanism.
mcas.authors: He, Feng, Bai, Haoyun, Zhang, Quan, Chen, Wenhao et al.
mcas.excerpt: Shu-Gan-Ning injection (SGN) is widely used clinically to treat hepatopathy, improve liver function, and enhance immunity. However, pseudo-allergic reactions (PARs) occur after administration and the causative compounds remain unclear.

mcas.title: Discovery of Pyrazolopyrimidines as Potent and Orally Bioavailable MRGPRX2 Antagonists.
mcas.authors: Nguyen, Minh H, Ye, Hai-Fen, Han, Heeoon, Li, Yong et al.
mcas.excerpt: The Mas-related G protein-coupled receptor X2 (MRGPRX2) mediates IgE-independent mast cell activation and is implicated in pseudoallergic drug reactions, chronic urticaria, atopic dermatitis, rosacea, neurogenic inflammation, and other mast cell-mediated disorders. Herein, we report the discovery of a pyrazolopyrimidine series as potent and orally bioavailable MRGPRX2 antagonists.

other-post-viral.title: Olfactory Disorders in Children: A Clinical Approach to Aetiologies, Psychophysical Testing and Therapeutics.
other-post-viral.excerpt: Olfaction is a critical physiological function, yet paediatric olfactory dysfunction remains poorly characterized compared to adult populations. This narrative review aims to synthesize current knowledge regarding the aetiology, diagnosis and management of olfactory disorders in children to provide a practical guide for general paediatricians and otolaryngologists.

other-post-viral.title: The probiotic dairy starter
other-post-viral.authors: Rousseaux, Christel, Illikoud, Nassima, Gagnaire, Valérie, Jan, Gwénaël
other-post-viral.excerpt: Irritable bowel syndrome (IBS), with a worldwide prevalence, may include abdominal pain, gut microbiota dysbiosis, increased gut permeability and low-grade inflammation and leads to increased perception of colorectal distension. Modulatory probiotics may help treating IBS.

other-post-viral.title: [Clinical efficacy, safety, and metabolomics study of Qingfei Runzao Granules in treatment of children with post-infectious cough].

A multicenter and randomized controlled trial design was adopted, including 64 cases of children with PIC from four tertiary class A hospitals in Shenyang.
